<cell id="96b013be"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type># Mean Listed Price by Genre

The Steam merchandising team wants to compare mean listed prices across eight major game genres and identify which genre has the highest average listed price.</cell id="96b013be">
<cell id="efe740f0"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## Load and prepare the data

Load the Steam dataset and prepare the listed price field for the genre comparison.</cell id="efe740f0">
<cell id="3768d1c2">import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd


STEAM_PATH = "../../data/steam/steam.csv"

TARGET_GENRES = [
    "Action",
    "Adventure",
    "Casual",
    "Indie",
    "RPG",
    "Strategy",
    "Simulation",
    "Sports",
]

steam = pd.read_csv(STEAM_PATH)

steam["price"] = pd.to_numeric(
    steam["price"],
    errors="coerce",
)

    f"{len(steam):,} games",
)

<cell id="dd45f65f"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## Inspect and prepare genre assignments

Inspect how genres are represented before selecting the requested categories. Games can contain multiple genre labels, so split these assignments and create one game–genre record for each label.</cell id="dd45f65f">
<cell id="a54af0a7">genre_counts_per_game = (
    steam["genres"]
    .fillna("")
    .str.split(";")
    .str.len()
)

multi_genre_count = (
    genre_counts_per_game > 1
).sum()

print(
    "Games with multiple genre labels:",
    f"{multi_genre_count:,}",
)

print(
    "Share of games with multiple genres:",
    f"{multi_genre_count / len(steam):.1%}",
)


genre_data = (
    steam
    .assign(
        genre=(
            steam["genres"]
            .fillna("")
            .str.split(";")
        )
    )
    .explode("genre")
)

genre_data["genre"] = (
    genre_data["genre"]
    .str.strip()
)

genre_data = genre_data[
    genre_data["genre"].isin(TARGET_GENRES)
].copy()

print(
    "\nGames represented in target genres:",
    f"{genre_data['appid'].nunique():,}",
)

print(

)</cell id="a54af0a7">

<cell id="a6bd4159"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## Calculate genre-level price statistics

Calculate the number of distinct games, mean listed price, and median listed price for each requested genre using the expanded genre assignments.</cell id="a6bd4159">
<cell id="de9406e6">genre_summary = (
    genre_data
    .groupby("genre")
    .agg(
        game_count=("appid", "nunique"),
        mean_price=("price", "mean"),
        median_price=("price", "median"),
    )
    .reindex(TARGET_GENRES)
    .reset_index()
)

print(
    genre_summary
    .round(
        {
            "mean_price": 2,
            "median_price": 2,
        }
    )
    .to_string(index=False)
)</cell id="de9406e6">

<cell id="e3c75a20"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## Rank genres by mean price

Rank the eight genres by mean listed price and identify the genre with the highest average.</cell id="e3c75a20">
<cell id="c5d3dbe8">genre_ranking = (
    genre_summary
    .sort_values(
        "mean_price",
        ascending=False,
    )
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

genre_ranking.index += 1
genre_ranking.index.name = "rank"


display_summary = genre_ranking.copy()

display_summary["mean_price"] = (
    display_summary["mean_price"]
    .map(lambda x: f"${x:.2f}")
)

display_summary["median_price"] = (
    display_summary["median_price"]
    .map(lambda x: f"${x:.2f}")
)


print("Genre ranking by mean price:")

print(
    display_summary[
        [
            "genre",
            "mean_price",
        ]
    ].to_string()
)


highest = genre_ranking.iloc[0]

print("\nFinal result:")

print(
    "Genre with the highest average price:",
    highest["genre"],
)

print(
    "Highest average price:",
    f"${highest['mean_price']:.2f}",

<cell id="9b8688ac"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## Visualize genre coverage

Compare the number of games represented in each requested genre after accounting for multi-genre assignments.</cell id="9b8688ac">
<cell id="7532f88e">plot_data = (

        ascending=False,
    )
)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(
    figsize=(9, 5)
)

)

)

)

        bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2,
        height,

        va="bottom",
        fontsize=9,

ax.text(
    0.98,
    0.96,
    (
        f"Games in dataset: {len(steam):,}\n"
    ),
    transform=ax.transAxes,
    ha="right",
    va="top",
    fontsize=9,
)
